stories.title: HDFC Bank, Reliance Industries rank among top ten stocks by DII holdings in Q2
stories.summary: The Economic Times reported that HDFC Bank and Reliance Industries were among the ten Indian equities that attracted the largest domestic institutional investor (DII) holdings during the second quarter. This placement shows the level of institutional buying in that period.
stories.why: High DII ownership can signal strong domestic institutional confidence and may affect future price momentum.

stories.title: NATO says it will defend against any space threats after reports of Russian nuclear satellite plan
stories.summary: NATO chief Mark Rutte said the alliance will defend against any threats in space after reports that Russia was preparing to launch a nuclear‑armed satellite. Intelligence reports about a possible launch within the next 60 days were shared among NATO members earlier this month, according to German media outlets. The source of the reports was not identified.
stories.why: The statement signals NATO’s readiness to address potential militarisation of space, which could alter global security dynamics.
stories.change: New high-signal event entered the brief.

stories.title: UK sanctions five Myanmar military leaders after ICJ genocide ruling
stories.summary: The United Kingdom imposed sanctions on five senior Myanmar military officials after the International Court of Justice ruled that Myanmar had carried out genocide against the Rohingya minority, marking the first time a state has been found guilty of the crime. The UK’s move follows public acknowledgments of the ruling by several other countries, including Australia, Belgium, Portugal, Spain and Canada.
stories.why: The sanctions demonstrate international accountability and increase pressure on Myanmar’s military over the alleged atrocities.
stories.change: New high-signal event entered the brief.

stories.title: Deepak Parekh flags missing housing starts data in India's economic indicators
stories.summary: Deepak Parekh addressed the Data Users Conference highlighting the lack of official housing start data in India. Parekh noted the recent revision of the GDP base year to 2022-23 and its implications for economic indicators.
stories.why: This matters because it can affect economic growth, prices, employment, borrowing costs or trade decisions.
stories.previousTitle: Deepak Parekh highlights lack of official housing‑starts data in India
stories.previousSummary: At the Data Users Conference, Deepak Parekh said India does not have official housing‑starts statistics, a metric he described as closely linked to many allied industries. He also noted the recent revision of the GDP base year to 2022‑23 and its impact on interpreting economic indicators, and urged the use of high‑frequency data to supplement quarterly GDP figures.

stories.title: RBI Governor asks NBFCs, housing finance firms to bolster cyber defences
stories.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra met with representatives of non‑banking finance companies and housing finance companies, urging them to strengthen cybersecurity measures. He called for a comprehensive, risk‑based approach to managing cyber threats and emphasized responsible credit growth and customer prioritisation. Participants also exchanged feedback on policy and operational issues affecting the NBFC sector.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.title: Amazon acquires Decart’s AI optimization technology for $7.5 billion
stories.summary: Amazon announced it will acquire Decart for $7.5 billion, obtaining the Decart Optimization Stack software that improves AI model efficiency on Nvidia, Amazon and Google hardware, along with Decart’s founding team and its AI researchers and engineers. The purchase is intended to bolster Amazon’s custom Trainium AI chips by providing a proven software layer for more efficient compute.
stories.why: The deal supplies Amazon with a ready‑made software stack to boost AI performance and reduce costs, strengthening its Trainium chip offering.

stories.title: Dog recovering from attack by another dog on Vancouver’s DTES
stories.summary: A Downtown Eastside resident is speaking out after a larger dog seriously injured his pet recently. Michael Brown told Global News his nine-year-old dog Cleto had to have surgery for a puncture on his backside after he was attacked by another dog.
